'''General Marcus Jonathan''' is a [[human]] [[quest giver]] located in the [[Valley of Heroes]] of [[Stormwind City]]. He is the general of [[Stormwind City]] and high commander of Stormwind Defense.

He and Reginald Windsor served together under [[Turalyon]] during the [[Second War]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|60R|The Great Masquerade}}</ref>
